clips.caption:
A mentor once told Kevin Trudeau: when you walk into any room, walk in like you own it.

Kevin said the obvious thing back - easy when you already have the money. The mentor's answer stuck for life: the money doesn't give you the attitude, the attitude gives you the money. When you're broke, just say you're a little illiquid at the moment.

Years later he watched a TV character use that exact line after losing everything, standing in front of a $30 million painting.

A man on one of his cruises waited two full years for a Rolex he couldn't afford, then paid cash the day it finally arrived.

Dream big before the money shows up.
